subject: AWS Marketplace launch: product tile readiness & co-sell wiring
messages:
From: Megan Huang <megan.huang@amazonaws.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: missing product tile fields & co-sell flag

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for engaging — we pulled your draft listing for Acme Analytics into the Marketplace queue and noticed a few gaps that will block publication and co-sell enablement. Can you please confirm timeline to provide the items below? Ideally we need everything within 5 business days to keep the planned Mar 10 launch.

Missing/Outstanding items (high level):
- SKU mapping file (CSV) linking Redwoods SKUs to Acme product SKUs
- Hero image (1600x900) + 3 supporting PNG/JPEG images
- One-paragraph product description (customer-facing) and 3 short bullets (feature callouts)
- Commercial terms: trial availability and private offer pricing (if applicable)
- Co-sell eligibility note: Partner tier & any existing co-sell commitments

Also: to flag the listing for co-sell we need a short Partner Solutions note from a PS/partnership owner (1-2 lines) that our field can use when reaching out to customers. If you can loop in the co-sell contact, that will speed approvals.

Attachments: marketplace-onboarding-template.xlsx (stub)

If you want we can do a 20-min sync tomorrow to walk the exact asset specs — say 10:30 PT?

Thanks,
Megan Huang
AWS Marketplace Partner Team
megan.huang@amazonaws.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Huang <megan.huang@amazonaws.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: missing product tile fields & co-sell flag

Hi Megan — thanks for the run-down. We can get these over but want to confirm a couple of things so we provide exactly what you need.

Quick answers / proposed owners:
- SKU mapping CSV: we will attach an initial mapping (Jonas to own final QA).
- Images: Kimberly will own hero + supporting images; will confirm exact files by EOD Mar 3.
- Copy: Ill draft the one-paragraph product description + bullets and post a Google doc link for edits.
- Commercials: We need to confirm whether Acme expects a private offer or public trial; Acme is in CC (marketplace@acmeanalytics.com) — can you confirm?
- Partner Solutions note: Jonas can provide the 1-2 line field note once co-sell designation is confirmed.

We can do the 20-min sync tomorrow at 10:30 PT to unblock specs. Please put the calendar invite on my behalf if that works.

Action items Ill own this week:
1) Upload SKU mapping (draft)
2) Share product copy doc for review
3) Kimberly to deliver hero image variants

Attaching: (will attach final in follow-up)

Best,
Priyom Das
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Huang <megan.huang@amazonaws.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Acme Analytics <marketplace@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: missing product tile fields & co-sell flag

Looping in product marketing to clarify copy and imagery. A few quick notes from the PMM side:

Copy guidance (short):
- Headline: emphasize low-latency inference + predictable pricing (two variants below).
- Product paragraph (customer-facing): keep to 1 short paragraph (<= 45 words) focused on outcomes (faster deployment, lower TCO).
- Bullets: 3 bullets; avoid deep implementation detail.

Suggested headlines (pick one):
1) "Low-latency LLM inference for production apps"
2) "Cost-efficient inference with predictable SLAs"
3) "Ship LLM features with consistent latency and lower cost"

CTA guidance: please use "Start free trial" only if a trial is actually provisioned; otherwise use "Contact sales". Acme said they want a limited trial for enterprise accounts — we should surface that as a private-offer footnote if we can.

Image specs reminder (Megan): hero 1600x900, 72-150ppi, PNG/JPEG. For the tile we prefer a version with whitespace for text overlay. Kimberly will send three variants by EOD Mar 3.

Jonas — please confirm the SKU mapping draft after Priyom uploads it.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: AWS Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@amazon.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Huang <megan.huang@amazonaws.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Acme Analytics <marketplace@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace onboarding: missing product tile fields & co-sell flag

Thanks everyone — quick clarifications so we can queue the listing correctly:

- Images: hero must be exactly 1600x900 for initial ingestion; we accept PNG/JPEG (no animated GIFs). Supporting images may be up to 1200x800. If we receive larger images we will resize but file quality can be impacted.
- SKU CSV: required columns: our_sku, partner_sku, sku_description, visibility (public/private). Please use the template in the onboarding checklist.
- Co-sell flag: to mark as co-sell eligible we need: (1) Partner tier (Standard/Premium) and (2) Partner Solutions note (1-2 lines) describing why this is a field-sell opportunity. This note is used by the GTM field.
- Trial CTA: if you cannot provision a public trial, please provide private offer instructions and the sample private-offer price.

Timeline note: our ingestion queue is tight this sprint — if you can get the above to us by COB Mon Mar 8 we can keep the target publish date of Mar 15. Otherwise the earliest publish will be Mar 22.

Doc links: onboarding template (https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/onboarding-template)

Attachments referenced: marketplace-guidelines-v3.pdf (stub)

> 3) "Ship LLM features with consistent latency and lower cost"

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Huang <megan.huang@amazonaws.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Acme Analytics <marketplace@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: missing product tile fields & co-sell flag

Thanks team — summary and next steps below. Attaching the initial asset pack and SKU mapping for ingestion.

What we attached (zip/pdf stubs):
- acme_asset_pack_v2.pdf (product paragraph, 3 bullets, 3 headline variants)
- product_tile_images.zip (hero_1600x900_v1.png, hero_1600x900_v2.png, supporting_01.jpg)
- sku_mapping_acme.csv (our_sku,partner_sku,sku_description,visibility)

Notes / asks:
- Private offer: Acme confirmed they want a limited enterprise trial via private offer. Acme will send private-offer pricing to Megan separately (Acme: marketplace@acmeanalytics.com).
- Partner Solutions note (for GTM): Jonas: suggested note below — please sign off or edit.

Proposed Partner Solutions note (draft):
"Redwood Inference + Acme Analytics: high-throughput inference optimized for enterprise deployment; recommended for customers needing predictable latency at scale. Field enablement kit available on request."

Jonas — can you confirm by EOD Mar 5 so Megan can mark co-sell eligibility?

Finally, Kimberly uploaded three hero variants and used whitespace on v2 for CTA overlay. Kimberly: please confirm final file names (I referenced them in the zip).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: acme_asset_pack_v2.pdf (application/pdf, stub); product_tile_images.zip (application/zip, stub); sku_mapping_acme.csv (text/csv, stub)
